items.name: X04_papyrus_unroll_b
items.text: close-up foley: a stiff dry papyrus scroll unrolled quickly on a wooden table, loud crisp crackle and paper flutter, ends with a soft slap as it lies flat

items.name: X04_papyrus_unroll_c
items.text: foley: old parchment scroll unrolling, crunchy crackling paper, close and clear

items.name: X06_boat_oars_b
items.text: two wooden oars pulling through calm water in a slow steady rhythm, clear splash and drip on every stroke, a wooden boat creaking, quiet river at night

items.name: X06_boat_oars_c
items.text: a small wooden rowing boat, slow oar strokes, each stroke a distinct dip, swirl and drip of water, calm and dark

items.name: X15_sickle_wheat_b
items.text: close-up foley: a curved metal sickle swiftly slicing through a bunch of dry wheat stalks, a sharp swish followed by a crisp crunchy cut, twice

items.name: X15_sickle_wheat_c
items.text: foley: one fast sickle cut through dry grain stalks, crisp swish and snap, close

items.name: X17_heart_on_pan_b
items.text: close-up foley: a raw wet heart dropped onto a small bronze dish, a clear squelchy thud and a short metallic ring

items.name: X17_heart_on_pan_c
items.text: foley: a soft wet piece of meat placed onto a metal plate, squishy thump with a brief bright metal ring

items.name: X12_scale_ding_b
items.text: one single soft bright metallic ding from a small brass bell, struck once, long gentle ring-out, nothing else
